title: What If One Tiny Fish Vanished From a Coral Reef?

scenes.text: What if one tiny fish vanished from a reef? Scientists actually tried it.
The fish is the cleaner wrasse. It eats parasites off bigger fish, and reef fish line up for it.
Researchers removed the cleaners from small patch reefs and kept them away for eight and a half years.
Resident fish became 37 percent less abundant, and 23 percent fewer species lived there.
Visiting fish dropped by 23 percent, and surgeonfish that graze on algae fell by 66 percent.
One small fish was holding a whole neighborhood together. Take it away, and the reef thins out.
